blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—The southwest monsoon, or habagat, season has officially ended, but the Intertropical Convergence Zone (ITCZ) will continue to bring rain to parts of the country, the state weather bureau said Monday. The Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical and Astronomical Services Administration (Pagasa) said changes in the prevailing weather pattern, including the strengthening of a high-pressure system over East Asia and the southward migration of the ITCZ, led to the weakening of habagat-related winds and rainfall.
